main_text.p: apostolus, quod est episcopo pro-prium, aptum esse ad docendum: & Hieronymus, si quis, inquit, plebe sibi sub ectam non instruit, nec a-postolus, nec propheta, nec epi-scopus, nec pastor est appellandus. Similia leguntur apud alios.

QUÆritur: An miracula, quæ proferuntur à Romanensibus, demonstrent, illorum ecclesia esse veram sponsam Christi, eorumq; prae-sules veros ac legitimos Dei servos: ac proinde audiendos? Romani pontif. affirmant, Orthodoxi Protestantes negant.

Orthodoxa thesis probatur. Nam Exod.7.14.25. & 8.8. legitur Ægyp-tios magos suis incantationibus edidisse miracula. Matth.7.22.23. Testatur Christus, multos sibi dicturos in die illo, Domine, nonne per nomen tuum prophetavimus, & per nomen tuum daemonia eje-cimus, & per nomen tuum multas virtutes edidimus? Dominum au-

page.notes: Page number 213 printed at the head. The scan shows the left edge of the facing page at the far left; it is excluded. The initial Q of "QUÆritur" is a large decorative capital, joined to its word. Some letters are faint; "sub ectam" and "praesules" are read as printed (the "s" long s is written as a plain s where it occurs). Italic passages are marked where the type is clearly italic; the mixed italic/roman in the question and answer lines is approximate.
